subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` block supervised Gateway `update.run` managed handoffs, or only configured background auto-update applies?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes the meaning of an existing operator env var from background auto-update control to explicit control-plane update suppression, which is a product and upgrade contract choice.

options.title: Block Gateway update handoffs
options.body: Treat the env var as an operator kill-switch for non-CLI Gateway-managed package/git update restarts and return a structured skipped response before handoff creation.

options.title: Keep explicit updates outside the kill-switch
options.body: Leave `update.run` behavior unchanged and update docs to say the env var only disables configured background auto-update applies.

options.title: Split into a new policy knob
options.body: Add a separate documented operator control for control-plane update requests if maintainers want to avoid broadening the existing env var.

recommendation.title: Block Gateway update handoffs
recommendation.body: Treat the env var as an operator kill-switch for non-CLI Gateway-managed package/git update restarts and return a structured skipped response before handoff creation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the core updater and Gateway restart flow and is the best available owner for the product contract choice.
